phase.goal: Define an implementation-ready, custom-engine one-lane MOBA slice without changing engine or generated files
in_scope: Git base and source authority reconciliation
Two-team one-lane gameplay and data contracts
Fixed-tick simulation, command, event, replay, and snapshot contracts
M4.1 cooker boundary and future typed-content seam
Dependency DAG, future write fences, acceptance tests, and hardware gates
Design receipt and independent verification handoff
out_of_scope: Authoritative simulation implementation
Networking or transport implementation
Renderer, UI, editor, or asset pipeline implementation
Changes to engine, game, tools, tests, assets, CMake, or generated output
Product balance decisions beyond the approved fixture
Owner-gated merge, deployment, or external engine selection
dependencies: M3.4 fixed-tick, replay, hash, and validation contracts
M4.0 asset registry and recorded acceptance evidence
phase.done_condition: The three new docs artifacts describe the accepted M4.1 base, all required custom-engine contracts, one-claim future slices with exact fences, observable acceptance tests, and held decisions; the docs-only diff and manifest checks pass
owner_decisions: Retain the custom C++/raw Vulkan engine
Use M4.1 commit 6571ee40 as the design base
Use the minimal fixed gameplay vocabulary
Implement local deterministic simulation first and keep network contracts ready

tasks.goal: Record the exact Git authority and preserve unrelated worktrees
tasks.context: The primary checkout is dirty and diverged while the active M4.1 cooker worktree is the clean accepted descendant of origin/main
tasks.output_contract: The slate and receipt name the source commit, accepted base, merge-base, active branch, design branch, worktree paths, and preservation rule

output_artifacts.description: Exact source and CHOONZ-MoBA Git authority record

tasks.done_check: The design worktree starts at 6571ee40, its merge-base with origin/main is e4b3369, and the primary and active owner worktrees remain unmodified
out_of_scope: Rebasing or merging the M4.1 branch
Repairing dirty or prunable worktrees
Changing origin refs

failure_states.trigger: The accepted base, active branch, or merge-base no longer matches the approved evidence
expected_evidence: Conflicting ref names and commit IDs

failure_states.trigger: The active M4.1 owner worktree changes during the lane

verification_handoff.method: Fresh Git status and exact-head review from the design worktree

tasks.goal: Define the gameplay, data, state, command, event, replay, snapshot, cooker, and presentation seams
tasks.context: The existing engine already owns fixed time, fixed-point simulation, ECS handles, replay/hash, asset loading, and presentation projection; the packet must extend those seams without moving authority
tasks.output_contract: The slate contains explicit field-ordered schemas, units, owners, deterministic tick order, data flow, and failure behavior with no implementation dependency outside the custom engine
tasks.done_check: The slate names MatchDef, TeamDef, SpawnDef, MapGrid, LaneDef, HeroDef, ActionDef, EffectDef, Command, CommandReject, SimEvent, snapshots, replay, cooker, and presentation ownership
out_of_scope: Adding public headers or C++ implementations
Changing the M4.1 binary format
Choosing held balance or map-art values

failure_states.trigger: A contract requires replacing or bypassing the custom C++/Vulkan engine
expected_evidence: The offending dependency or proposed seam
The existing engine seam it would bypass

failure_states.trigger: A field, unit, owner, or version differs between schema, flow, and acceptance sections

verification_handoff.method: Fresh-context contract walk checking every schema against the authority map and acceptance list
expected_evidence: Every authoritative value has one owner
Renderer and presentation cannot mutate SimWorld

tasks.goal: Break the design into one-claim implementation slices with dependency and writer fences
tasks.context: Map, commands, content, combat, objectives, authority, and presentation have different ownership and some share engine/sim
tasks.output_contract: The slate gives each slice a single claim, prerequisites, M4.1 dependency flag, future write fence, and serial/parallel rule

output_artifacts.description: Future implementation sequence and ownership fences

tasks.done_check: The minimum local vertical path is ordered from map/navigation through commands, content, combat, and lane/objective closure, with replication and presentation as consumers
out_of_scope: Minting implementation lanes
Writing engine or test files
Parallel claims over the same simulation fence

failure_states.trigger: Two future slices claim the same mutable subsystem without an explicit serial dependency

expected_evidence: Every slice states whether it builds on M4.1
No concurrent simulation writer is implied

tasks.goal: Define observable design checks, future executable scenarios, and honest hardware gates
tasks.context: This lane writes no code, so it must specify future executable acceptance without claiming fresh implementation results
tasks.output_contract: The slate lists docs-only checks, deterministic/replay/content/network scenarios, and the future CMake/CTest/offline-SPIR-V/hardware gate

output_artifacts.description: Observable acceptance and hardware gate contract

tasks.done_check: The acceptance section distinguishes executed docs checks from future code tests and does not claim a fresh M4.1 CMake/CTest or hardware run
out_of_scope: Running or modifying implementation tests
Claiming unavailable hardware or CI evidence
Changing the established simulation oracle without implementation evidence

failure_states.trigger: The packet reports a build, test, hardware, or PR result that was not directly observed
expected_evidence: Missing command output or receipt row

verification_handoff.method: Independent acceptance review of command/check evidence and future scenario coverage

tasks.goal: Close the durable design receipt with branch, commit, PR, checks, and unresolved gates
tasks.context: The lane must hand off a reviewable docs-only PR and never self-merge
tasks.output_contract: The receipt names the actual branch, final head, PR target/URL, artifact paths, checks, preserved worktrees, and remaining held decisions
tasks.done_check: The pushed PR is docs-only relative to the accepted M4.1 base, the receipt is updated with actual delivery evidence, and no merge was performed
out_of_scope: Merging or approving the PR
Promoting to a vault or non-Git system
Opening implementation lanes automatically

read_paths: Git status, diff, log, and remote refs

failure_states.trigger: The proposed commit or PR contains a path outside the three new docs artifacts
The active M4.1 remote branch cannot be used as the docs-only PR base

verification_handoff.method: Fresh-context review of the pushed branch, PR metadata, and final receipt
